metadata.question: Did Sacramento, California experience 2-meter air temperatures above 110 degrees fahrenheit in September 2022?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use ECMWF ERA5-Land HOURLY (ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY) for 2 m temperature over a 15 km buffer around Sacramento (Point[-121.4944, 38.5816]) from 2022-09-01 to 2022-10-01. If empty, fallback to ECMWF ERA5 HOURLY.
2. Masking strategy: Not applicable (reanalysis has full coverage; no cloud masking).
3. Logic for validity: Check collection size; if zero after fallback -> C1. Compute per-pixel temporal max, then regional max and pixel count. If count=0 -> C2. If max is null or outside plausible range (200–350 K) -> C3. Compare converted Fahrenheit to 110°F for A/B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const sacPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-121.4944, 38.5816]);
    const region = sacPoint.buffer(15000).bounds(); // 15 km buffer to capture grid cell(s)
    const start = '2022-09-01';
    const end = '2022-10-01'; // exclusive

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback
    let dataset = 'ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY';
    let col = ee.ImageCollection(dataset)
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filterBounds(region)
      .select('temperature_2m');
    let size = await col.size().getInfo();

    if (!size || size === 0) {
      dataset = 'ECMWF/ERA5/HOURLY';
      col = ee.ImageCollection(dataset)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(region)
        .select('temperature_2m');
      size = await col.size().getInfo();
    }

    if (!size || size === 0) {
      console.log('Dataset tried: ERA5-LAND, ERA5');
      console.log('Images (hours): 0');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing: temporal max across September 2022, then regional stats
    const tmax = col.max(); // per-pixel max over time
    const scale = 10000;

    const maxDict = await tmax.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.max(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true
    }).getInfo();

    const countDict = await tmax.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true
    }).getInfo();

    const maxK = maxDict ? maxDict['temperature_2m'] : null;
    const pixCount = countDict ? countDict['temperature_2m'] : 0;

    if (!pixCount || pixCount === 0) {
      console.log(`Dataset: ${dataset}`);
      console.log(`Images (hours): ${size}`);
      console.log('Valid pixels: 0');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    if (maxK === null || maxK === undefined || !(isFinite(maxK)) || maxK < 200 || maxK > 350) {
      console.log(`Dataset: ${dataset}`);
      console.log(`Images (hours): ${size}`);
      console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixCount}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const maxF = (maxK - 273.15) * 9/5 + 32;

    // 4. Output concise evidence
    console.log(`Region: Sacramento, CA (15 km buffer)`);
    console.log(`Dataset: ${dataset}`);
    console.log(`Images (hours): ${size}`);
    console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixCount}`);
    console.log(`Max T2m: ${maxK.toFixed(2)} K (${maxF.toFixed(2)} F)`);

    // 5. Final Answer
    if (maxF > 110) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
